title: Rewrite tag

fields.name: emitter_mem_buf_limit
fields.description: Set a limit on the amount of memory the tag rewrite emitter can consume if the outputs provide backpressure.

fields.name: emitter_name
fields.description: Use this property to configure an optional name for the internal emitter plugin that handles filters emitting a record under the new tag.

fields.name: emitter_storage.type
fields.description: Define a buffering mechanism for the new records created.

fields.name: rule
fields.description: Defines the matching criteria and the format of the tag for the matching record.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
